edits.new: Write a concise title naming the most specific topic under which all these instances belong, rather than describing the instances as text. If every instance expresses the same named thing, use that name exactly as the instances write it, without a gloss.
edits.old: Write a concise title naming the category these instances belong to, rather than describing the instances as text. If every instance expresses the same named thing, use that name exactly as the instances write it, without a gloss. Otherwise, name the smallest genuine category containing what every instance refers to.

edits.new: Make relationships that define the topic explicit in the title. Every instance must belong under the title.
edits.old: Make relationships that define the category explicit in the title. Each instance must support the title's full meaning on its own.
